verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs state that outgoing ACH transfers take 1–3 business days and that domestic and international wires can send same-day, with a delivery estimate shown before confirming. Its bill pay feature lets users pay vendors the way they want to be paid, and community reviews corroborate outgoing ACH, including same-day ACH on Pro. missing for 10: a step-by-step how-to for sending domestic ACH or wire payments to vendors, and documentation of domestic wire fees and limits.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send domestic ACH and wire payments to vendors

citations.quote: ACH transfers take 1–3 business days; wires (domestic and international) can send same-day. You'll see the exact delivery estimate before confirming.
Upload bills, delegate tasks, automate approvals, and pay vendors the way they want to be paid.
if your business needs faster, same-day ACH and more advanced billing features, then the Relay Pro plan will set you back $30 per business/month
